question: Which of the following servers convert IP addresses to domain names?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**DNS.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **DNS** serves to manage which server a **user will access when they enter a domain name into their web browser by converting requests for names into IP addresses.**
 
• In order for browsers to load internet resources, **DNS converts domain names into IP addresses.** 
 
• **DNS changes the domain names to IP addresses so that browsers can load internet resources.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
